17 Barbados hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 30, 2026 for Nov 4 to Nov 6, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Barbados hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 18 Barbados hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, the hotel's own site at 2, Traveluro at 2, Agoda at 1, Booking.com at 1, Hotels.com at 1, TravelUp at 1, Tripadvisor.com at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them. These are the Barbados rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 15 of the 17 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 11, Billabook.com at 1, momondo.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and Traveluro at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 2, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 2 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line, and the study also counts the 1 named below that are not listed on this page. Taxes and fees at Barbados hotels

At the 15 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 12% ($30 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Saint Peter’s Bay Barbados to 19% at Radisson Aquatica Resort Barbados. At 2 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
